source_title: DUG and VAST Data unlock speed, scale and simplicity to power HPCaaS.
claim_relevant_visible_text: VAST is built on a high-performance, high-duty cycle Intel Optane cache in front of a huge amount of Quad-level cell (QLC) Flash storage. Once data has stopped changing, it is migrated from the Optane to the QLC.
researcher_paraphrase: DUG Technology, describing the VAST system used for its HPCaaS workloads, states that the architecture places a large QLC flash tier behind Intel Optane cache.
precision_guard: This is a named customer-owner deployment precedent from 2022. It does not identify the QLC SSD vendor/model and must not be represented as a 2024 P5336 or GB200 deployment.
authority_boundary: DUG Technology is customer-primary for its own deployed storage experience and architecture description; it is not primary for the manufacturing identity of the underlying QLC drives.
